news_output: GoKwik launched Kwik Ads, an agentic AI performance-marketing platform for Indian D2C brands. Kwik Ads uses autonomous AI agents for signal enrichment (claims >200 Meta-compatible purchase signals from a 200M shopper network), creative research, benchmarking, and analysis. GoKwik says the platform supplies higher-quality purchase signals to ad algorithms (Meta signals partnership and Meta Agency Partner status cited), and reports early results: ~25% improvement in ROAS and ~15% reduction in CAC for participating brands, with customer case examples and partners (Personal Touch Skincare, Pee Safe, Bombay Shaving Company, What’s Up Wellness, Saada). Kwik Ads is available for demos and is positioned to impact creative testing, signal-based targeting, attribution inputs, and AI-assisted campaign setup for Indian advertisers.

news_output: DPIIT / Gazette notification (S.O. 1860(E)) published 2026-04-13: Government has notified the 'Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0' (Startup India FoF 2.0) with a total corpus of Rs. 10,000 crore to mobilize venture capital for the startup ecosystem. Scheme scope emphasises segmented support (deep-tech, micro-VCs, manufacturing/Make in India, sector-agnostic), SIDBI as implementing agency (with additional IAs possible), VCIC/Empowered Committee governance, up to 5% of returns earmarked for ecosystem capacity building, and operational guidelines to be issued by DPIIT. Practical impact: increases available government-backed capital for AIFs investing in startups and signals focused support for deep-tech/manufacturing and early-growth micro-VCs.

news_output: Google announced updates to consent controls between Google Analytics and Google Ads: Ads settings will take control over ad-side data usage aligned with user consent. Starting 2026-06-15, tags/SDKs will apply destination-specific controls (Ads Consent Mode governs data used by Google Ads; Google Signals/API governs Analytics). If Google Signals is disabled, Ads may use consented cookies unless ad_storage is explicitly set to denied; a 90-day grace period is available. This changes how tracking/attribution and tag configuration should be managed across linked properties.
